description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source project and is responsible for listing requirements with optional custom field data in an ExtJS table. It initializes page settings, retrieves requirements and related data from the database, constructs a detailed table with sorting, filtering, and grouping features, and outputs the result for display.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class used to create and manage external tables for displaying requirement data with sorting, grouping, and filtering capabilities.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Initializes the TestLink page environment with database connection and settings.

methods.name: templateConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves template configuration settings such as directories and default templates.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Loads and returns configuration settings related to the project, including display formats and coverage management flags.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes user input arguments, including user session, selected test project, and version options.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI data structure, setting page title, messages, and project info based on user input.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for accessing requirement management views.
